description: Email giving a scheduling line and hours.

event.subject: Re: Appointment request
event.body:
Hello,

We do not book new patients by email. Please call our scheduling line at +1 202-555-0147, Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 4:30 pm Eastern, and a scheduler will help you.

Thank you,
Riverbend Scheduling Office

expected.rationale: The office asks the patient to phone the scheduling line during stated hours.
expected.quote: Please call our scheduling line at +1 202-555-0147
expected.hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 4:30 pm Eastern
